newsitem.title: CHINA: China sentences dissident to nine years in prison.
newsitem.headline: China sentences dissident to nine years in prison.

text.p: A Chinese court has sentenced dissident Li Hai to nine years in prison for prying into state secrets, a family member said on Friday.
Beijing's Chaoyang District Court convicted Li around December 18, a relative said by telephone.
"We're very surprised," the relative told Reuters, adding that he believed the appeal process had already started.
The family has not been allowed to meet Li since he was detained on May 31, 1995.

Li was first arrested on May 31, 1990 for his role in the 1989 student demonstrations for democracy. He was released six months later and expelled from the philosophy department of the prestigious Beijing University where he was a graduate student.
